in_marathi.name: Bhuvan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhuvan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhuvan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bhuvah', meaning 'earth'. It is a name of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, and is associated with the earth element. In Hindu mythology, Bhuvan is believed to be the protector and nurturer of all living beings and is often invoked for prosperity, growth, and stability.
